items.title: Why AEP's Plant Fight Could Make ETFs Worth A Look

Simply Wall St flags that its interest payments are not well covered by earnings, and that a 3.04% dividend is not well covered by free cash flows. A fund that holds American Electric Power Company alongside many other businesses dilutes how much those issues or any upside in the shares can move your portfolio.
